summary: Defines the Group Security Policy Token, a structure that spells out the security policy and settings for a cryptographic group such as a secure multicast group. Because group security depends on many services working together, an authenticatable description of what every part of the system must support helps keep them consistent. This is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: A club has house rules written on a card that is signed so nobody can fake it. Everyone who joins reads the same card and follows the same rules, so the whole club stays safe together.

questions: how to describe security policy for multicast group
